response.sql:
WITH district_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    account.district_id,
    COUNT(*) as account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY account.district_id
),
total_accounts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM account
),
num_districts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) as num FROM account
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.account_count,
    dc.account_count::REAL / ta.total as share,
    dc.account_count::REAL / ta.total - 1.0 / nd.num as difference_from_avg
  FROM district_counts dc, total_accounts ta, num_districts nd
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    district_id,
    account_count,
    share,
    difference_from_avg,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC) as rnk
  FROM district_stats
)
SELECT 
  district_id,
  account_count,
  share,
  difference_from_avg
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC

assumptions.assumption: Only districts that appear in the account table (have at least one account) are included; districts in the district reference table with no accounts are excluded.
The 'average share across districts' is 1 / (count of distinct district_ids), representing even distribution. This is mathematically equivalent to the mean of all district shares.
